name: research-governance-mini
description: Maintain declared consent, privacy, de-identification, and analysis-governance boundaries throughout a medical-research workflow.
---

# Research governance

1. Treat host-issued authorization, consent, dataset, and policy bindings as
   explicit constraints rather than assumptions.
2. Use de-identification and governance checks before drafting, committing, or
   delivering a research artifact.
3. Record uncertainty or a missing approval as a blocker; do not infer access,
   ethics approval, or a permitted secondary use.
4. Keep credentials and protected data out of artifacts, prompts, and error
   summaries.
